verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Obsidian is a Markdown editor (notes stored as Markdown plain text) with keyboard-centric tooling: a Command Palette, a Vim mode mentioned by a community user, and a mobile editing toolbar. A user also reports it can replace Sublime for daily dev notes. Specific formatting elements are only implied by Markdown, and one user notes PDF embedding and annotation trail Logseq. missing for 10: explicit documentation of headings, callouts, tables, code blocks and embedded media; evidence of editor speed; independent hands-on corroboration of the formatting features.
